newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank PBK to take over small Bank Morski.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank PBK to take over small Bank Morski.

text.p: The Polish central bank, Banking Guarantee Fund, PBR and Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) signed a letter of intent to cooperate in taking over small Polish Bank Morski by PBK, PBR's spokeswoman said.

Marzena Kowalska told Reuters on Wednesday that it was necessary for all the four institutions to cooperate in taking over the bank, currently in the process of liquidation, by PBK, but declined to give details.
"The content of the letter of intent is such that it concerns all four institutions, but it's only a letter of intent and I can't give any more details," she said.
Morski's current main shareholders are PBR, whose full name is is Polish Development Bank, with 68.3 percent of Morski and Westdeutsche Landesbank, which has 22.6 percent.
The state-owned PBK is slated for privatisation later this year.
